title: (To-be-deprecated) Get recommended budgets
content_data:
> **Important**
> This endpoint will be deprecated in the next API version. We recommend that you migrate to [/tool/diagnosis/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738674986981378) and obtain the budget estimated delivery results through the response parameter `budget_edr_info`. Use this endpoint to get 15 sets of recommended budgets and the corresponding estimated conversion data for each budget on the same day when the budget is adopted. See [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1746463333984258) to find out the preconditions for and the steps of getting budget estimated delivery results. >**Note**
  • Budget estimated delivery results are given according to your ad group setting. If you evaluate multiple ad groups of the same setting via this endpoint , you can only get results for the earliest ad group.
## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/delivery/budget/recommend/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {required} |string| Advertiser ID. | | adgroup_ids {required} | string[] | Ad group IDs. The number of IDs cannot exceed 20. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/delivery/budget/recommend/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&adgroup_ids=["{{adgroup_id}}"]' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{35%}|Data Type{10%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number| Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string| Response message. For details, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |request_id |string| The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object| Returned data. | #| results |object[] | List of ad group IDs and corresponding budget recommendation results.| ##| adgroup_id | string | Ad group ID. | ##| recommendations | object[] | 15 sets of data for recommended budget raise ratios from -20% to 50% with a step of 5%, and corresponding estimated results. | ###| recommended_budget | float| Recommended budget. Please adopt one suitable budget using [/adgroup/budget/update/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739591133130817) within the same day (advertiser account time zone). | ###| budget_increase_ratio | float | Estimated budget raise ratio. | ###| estimated_conversion | integer | Estimated conversion. | ###| conversion_uplift | integer | Estimated conversion uplift. | ###| conversion_uplift_ratio | float | Estimated conversion uplift ratio. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id":
